description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 Workforce Technology and Insights (WTI) is helping shape the future of work across Micron’s People organization. We bring together business transformation, process redesign, technology, AI, data, and workforce insights to reimagine how work gets done and create better experiences for employees and leaders.

 Our team partners closely with People leaders and functional teams to identify high-value opportunities, simplify and redesign workflows, and rapidly translate business challenges into scalable solutions. As Micron advances toward a more AI-native organization, WTI is building the capabilities needed to enable people and AI to work together effectively, responsibly, and at scale.
 The Applied AI Engineer is a business-facing technologist who works directly with People teams to identify opportunities, redesign processes, rapidly build AI-enabled solutions, and own delivery from business problem through deployed outcome.

 This is not a traditional software engineering role and not a consulting role that stops at recommendations. The Applied AI Engineer combines business acumen, process engineering, AI solution design, hands-on coding, and delivery ownership to turn workforce challenges into working solutions.

 The role supports the WTI team’s direction of integrating process, human roles, AI agents, technology, data, and controls as one system, while building reusable transformation capabilities.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Partner directly with People leaders, COEs, Global People Shared Services, and other stakeholders to understand business problems and desired outcomes; translate ambiguous challenges into clearly defined use cases, requirements, hypotheses, and success measures.
 Advise stakeholders on whether AI, agents, automation, workflow redesign, or traditional technology are appropriate, balancing business value, employee experience, feasibility, risk, and speed.
 Map current-state workflows to identify friction, manual work, handoffs, bottlenecks, and decision points, using approaches such as journey mapping, value-stream mapping, and process decomposition where appropriate.
 Redesign workflows before applying technology and design future-state human + AI workflows that clearly define where human judgment, accountability, and technology should sit.
 Translate future-state workflows into AI solution designs and personally build rapid prototypes and MVPs, including AI agents, prompts, workflows, APIs, integrations, retrieval experiences, and lightweight applications, to test opportunities with users.
 Work across Python, APIs, JSON, SQL, agent frameworks, Microsoft AI technologies, low-code platforms, and other approved enterprise tools, determining when solutions can be built directly and when deeper enterprise engineering is required.
 Own opportunities end to end, from discovery, process redesign, solution design, prototyping, and validation through the production pathway, adoption, and value realization; establish milestones, dependencies, risks, and success measures and remain accountable for delivery while partnering closely with Technology, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, Architecture, and other required teams.
 Build for reuse and scale by turning successful solutions into reusable agents, components, integrations, prompts, patterns, and accelerators; document architecture and lessons learned, contribute to an enterprise library of Applied AI capabilities, and help establish practical engineering, evaluation, governance, and responsible-AI standards. 
  
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, information systems, business, analytics, or a related discipline.
 5+ years of relevant experience across software engineering, AI, technology consulting, automation, product development, or business transformation.
 Demonstrated experience personally building technical solutions using code.
 Experience translating business needs into working technology solutions.
 Experience delivering solutions across multiple organizational and technical stakeholders.
 Strong written and verbal executive communication skills.
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with enterprise AI, GenAI, agentic systems, or intelligent automation.
 Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Workday, or ServiceNow.
 Experience with Python, APIs, SQL, orchestration, RAG, or agent frameworks.
 Knowledge of HR/People processes is beneficial but not required. I would prioritize outstanding builders with business judgment over candidates who simply have deep HR technology backgrounds.
 
 The US base salary range that Micron Technology estimates it could pay for this full-time position is: 
 
$133,000.00 - $227,000.00 a year 
 Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses and equity.
Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base pay for new hire salaries of the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional job-related factors, including knowledge, skills, experience, tenure and relevant education or training. The pay scale is subject to change depending on business needs. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. 

Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits . 
 
 
 Micron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
 
 To learn about your   right to work click here. 
 
 To learn more about Micron, please visit micron.com/careers 
 
 US Sites Only: To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact Micron’s People Organization at  hrsupport_na@micron.com or 1-800-336-8918 (select option #3)
 
 Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.
 
 Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.
 
 AI alert : Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.   
 
 Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.
